caseName: Red Ball Motor Freight, Inc. v. Shannon
caseNameFull: Red Ball Motor Freight, Inc. v. Shannon, doing business as E. & R. Shannon and United States v. Shannon, doing business as E. & R. Shannon
attorneys: Phillip Robinson, Amos M. Mathews, Roland Rice and John C. Bradley for appellants in No. 406. Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Orrick, Lionel Kestenbaum, Elliott H. Moyer, Robert W. Ginnane and Fritz R. Kahn for the United States et al. Appellees pro se. Robert E. Redding for Transportation Association of America, as amicus curiae, in support of both appeals. James E. Wilson for the Common Carrier Conference — Irregular Route of the American Trucking Associations, Inc., as amicus curiae, in support of the appeal in No. 421.

opinions.text:
Appeals from the United States District Court for the Western District of Texas. The motion of Transportation Association of America for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, is granted. The motion of the Common Carrier Conference — Irregular Route of the American Trucking Associations, Inc., for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, in No. 421 is granted. Probable jurisdiction noted.

Reported below: 219 F. Supp. 781.
